source: World Health Organization (WHO) & Ministry of Health Guidelines

firstAidGuides.title: CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation)
steps: Place the person on their back on a firm, flat surface.
Position your hands in the center of the chest and perform hard, fast compressions (100-120 bpm).
doNot: Do not stop compressions until emergency help arrives.

firstAidGuides.title: Thermal / Heat Burns
steps: Cool burn under cool running tap water for at least 10–20 minutes.
Remove clothing/jewelry near burn before swelling starts.
Cover loosely with clean non-stick sterile cloth.
doNot: Do NOT use ice, butter, oil, or toothpaste on the burn.

firstAidGuides.title: Choking (Heimlich Maneuver)
steps: Stand behind the person and wrap arms around waist.
Place fist above navel and perform quick upward abdominal thrusts.
doNot: Do not perform abdominal thrusts on infants under 1 year.

symptomsMatrix.precaution: Rest in a quiet room, drink water, apply cool compress.

symptomsMatrix.precaution: Avoid spicy foods, drink warm water, sit upright after meals.

recommendations: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity weekly.
Keep dietary sodium intake under 2,000 mg (approx. 5g salt) per day.
Regularly monitor blood pressure (target below 120/80 mmHg).
Maintain a balanced diet rich in whole grains, legumes, vegetables, and lean proteins.
Perform routine fasting blood glucose checks annually for adults over 30.
Limit refined sugars and processed beverages.
